info.description: Live crypto prices in USD. Each call costs $0.001 USDC on Base (chain 8453), paid via the x402 protocol (v2, exact scheme, EIP-3009). A call without payment returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header containing the payment requirements; retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Payout wallet: 0xd7d8299ea24a1ff9225ee04587dbc42506a302b6. Price source: CoinGecko free public API.
info.title: vapi-price-api

get.description: Returns the live USD price of a cryptocurrency from CoinGecko. Paid endpoint: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (exact scheme). Without a payment the server answers HTTP 402 with the payment requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; sign the EIP-3009 authorization and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

402.description: Payment Required — x402 challenge. The PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header carries a base64-encoded PaymentRequired object (x402Version 2) with an accepts array: scheme "exact", network "eip155:8453" (Base), amount "1000" (USDC base units = $0.001, 6 decimals), asset "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913" (USDC on Base), payTo "0xd7d8299ea24a1ff9225ee04587dbc42506a302b6", maxTimeoutSeconds 300. Sign the EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 PaymentRequired JSON object.
